weathercheck: WeatherCheck uses the OpenWeatherMap API to provide the current weather and 10-day forecast for a given city.
jobjolly: Jobjolly is a web application that lets users search for jobs across the U.S. This application uses the CareerBuilder API.
real-estate-agents-android: See recent sales, client reviews, and market forecasts of real estate agents operating in your neighborhood.
youtube-instant: Instant videos, instant classic. This mashup landed its creator a job offer over Twitter from YouTube co-founder Chad Hurley.
box.net-and-live-documents: This integration allows Box users to send documents directly to Live Documents, edit them, and save them back to Box.
blog-posting-box.net: Allows users to create Blog posts on Blogger, LiveJournal, and WordPress directly from their Box.net accounts while sharing Box content.
aumio: Aumio sends scheduled alerts to friends and coworkers by e-mail, text, and phone
repeaterstore-automated-tracking: Provides an automated order tracking system for customers of the e-commerce business, RepeaterStore.com.
tubegotchi-movies: Top 10 box office movies this week. Has YouTube trailers and Hulu latest TV and movies.
akaber-continuous-video: With Akaber.com, your YouTube search result clips keep playing for you as you watch them.
wantmymedia: Search, watch and download any YouTube video.
imusix: Mashup that aggregates music videos from YouTube with a search interface.
lyrics-and-clips: Collection of songs and video clips with their lyrics.
neave.tv: A mash-up of the most creative videos found on Google Video, YouTube, Blip.tv and other video sharing sites.
delancey: This nice del.icio.us enhancement allows you to see which of your del.icio.us bookmarks are used most frequently. By DeWitt Clinton.
del.icio.us-direc.tor: Ajax-style prototype for an alternative web-based rich UI for del.icio.us
